newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU ministers preparing for Brussels lira meeting.
newsitem.headline: EU ministers preparing for Brussels lira meeting.

text.p: European Union finance ministers are preparing to come to Brussels on Sunday to resolve difficulties in Italy's attempt to rejoin the EU's exchange rate mechanism (ERM), an EU official said on Saturday.
"They have been put on stand-by," the official told Reuters.
Earlier on Saturday, official talks between senior central bank and finance ministry officials on Italy's re-entry into the ERM were described by participants as difficult.
Finance ministers are brought in to deal with such issues when reaching a decision becomes too politically charged for the officials, grouped in the Europran Unions monetary commitee.
Italy wants to rejoin the ERM at weaker rate than some other countries believe it appropriate.
